panels.title: Numeric Drift — system_load_before_outage (serving vs. training baseline)
panels.description: Live serving average vs. the promoted champion's training-time mean. A growing gap signals input drift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '5m') AS time, AVG(system_load_before_outage) AS serving_avg FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT generate_series($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), interval '5 minutes') AS time, (SELECT ts.stat_mean FROM training_stats ts JOIN training_runs tr ON tr.id = ts.training_run_id WHERE tr.is_champion = true AND ts.feature_name = 'system_load_before_outage' LIMIT 1) AS training_baseline

panels.title: Categorical Drift — cloud_provider distribution (serving)
panels.description: Share of each cloud_provider value among served predictions over time. Compare shape against the training baseline table below.

targets.rawSql: WITH bucketed AS (SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '5m') AS time, cloud_provider FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)) SELECT time, cloud_provider, (COUNT(*)::float / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY time)) * 100 AS pct FROM bucketed GROUP BY time, cloud_provider ORDER BY time

panels.title: Training Baseline — cloud_provider distribution
panels.description: Champion model's training-time category distribution, for visual comparison against the serving distribution above.

targets.rawSql: SELECT jsonb_each(ts.category_distribution) AS provider_pct FROM training_stats ts JOIN training_runs tr ON tr.id = ts.training_run_id WHERE tr.is_champion = true AND ts.feature_name = 'cloud_provider'

panels.title: Average Predicted Duration (hours) by Model Version
panels.description: Model behavior over time — a sudden jump can indicate a bad promotion. Split by model_version to see the before/after effect of a retrain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '5m') AS time, model_version, AVG(predicted_hours) AS avg_predicted_hours FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1, model_version ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Anomaly Rate (% predictions > 5h)
panels.description: Share of predictions flagged as anomalies over time. A sudden spike suggests the model is misbehaving, not necessarily that outages got worse.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(timestamp, '5m') AS time, (SUM(CASE WHEN is_anomaly THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS anomaly_pct FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
